thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: Sev2 — elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (canary pool: dragoon-v2). Thresholds breached 3m ago. Routed to #incidents and on-call.

oncall-alex: I'm on it. Pulling logs + dashboards.

eng-sre-maya: Confirming 5xx spike and P95 latency jump on canary nodes. Redis KV miss rate up for dragoon instances. Error payloads look like kernel quant decode errors.

rl-deploy-sam: Deployed dragoon-v2 to 10% canary at 04:15 UTC. Canary controllers show healthy but telemetry disagrees — canary autosmoke didn't flag. Investigating rollout controller logs now.

platform-ops-lina: Is there a fast kill-switch for model routing? I can flip traffic to stable.

oncall-alex: Yes flag is `route:dragoon`. Lina, please flip to false.

platform-ops-lina: Doing it now.

platform-ops-lina: ```bash
# flip feature flag to route away from dragoon
curl -X POST https://flags.internal.redwood/api/flip 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' 
  -d '{"flag":"route:dragoon","value":false}'
```

incident-bot: ACTION: flag.flip succeeded by platform-ops-lina at 04:22 UTC — traffic for dragoon-route set to 0%.

eng-sre-maya: Seeing immediate drop in error rate from canary group. Start draining existing dragoon pods.

rl-deploy-sam: Manual rollback in progress: pinning model-routing to dragoon-v1 and revoking new variant. Command: 
```bash
redwoodctl rollout revert --pool canary --model dragoon --to-version v1 --reason "quantization mismatch"
```

qa-anya: Kicking off smoke/regression checklist against endpoint (small sample prompts). Will post results.

cust-success-john: Notified top-5 impacted accounts to monitor; no customer-reported data loss, only degraded responses per monitoring alert.

qa-anya: Smoke results: all 6 sanity prompts returned 200 and expected structured tokens. One sample had truncated tokens before revert; now OK.

eng-sre-maya: Metrics: 5xx back to baseline within 3 minutes of flag flip. Latency returning to normal. Drains progressing; CPU stabilizing. KV misses declining.

oncall-alex: Confirm auto-rollback failed to trigger — reason: rollout controller saw success criteria (pod ready) but didn't parse per-token telemetry. Filing quick item.

rl-deploy-sam: Filed issue: "rollout: canary telemetry mismatch — controller ignores model decode errors" and assigned to eng-ml for follow-up.

platform-ops-lina: I've left the kill-switch flipped off (route:dragoon=false) to prevent accidental reintroduction while we investigate.

cust-success-john: Reached out to the handful of customers who had increased error traces and offered status + mitigation steps. No escalations yet.

eng-sre-maya: Running additional verification: synthetic traffic ramp to 5% stable traffic for 10min — looks clean.

qa-anya: Started regression run (n=250 prompts) against stable route; preliminary pass 98%. Dumping failed cases to /tmp/dragoon-regr-5171237890.log.

oncall-alex: Good work. Immediate mitigation complete. Next: postmortem. Sam + Maya to lead. Include: root cause hypothesis (quant mismatch on compiled kernels), why auto-rollback didn't trigger, and checklist for kill-switch playbook updates.

rl-deploy-sam: Will prepare initial incident timeline and gather rollout controller + model compile logs.

eng-sre-maya: Adding perf traces and kernel logs to the ticket. Will propose an additional smoke gate in rollout controller that validates model decode correctness on a prompt set.

platform-ops-lina: I'll document the manual flip steps and add a short snippet to the playbook for on-call.

cust-success-john: I'll follow up with customers once the postmortem is ready.

incident-bot: NOTE: Incident marked as mitigated at 04:28 UTC (flag flip + rollback successful). Logging event: incident/5171237890/mitigated.

oncall-alex: Closing slack thread for live coordination. We'll re-open if any regressions appear. Thanks all :thumbsup:

qa-anya: Leaving regression artifacts in the ticket and uploading sample diffs.

rl-deploy-sam: Action items: (1) postmortem (owner: sam) (2) rollout controller fix (owner: eng-ml) (3) playbook update (owner: platform-ops-lina). ETA for postmortem draft EOD tomorrow.

eng-sre-maya: Copy. Setting follow-up meeting for 24h to review.

oncall-alex: Signing off from on-call — handing over to nightshift deputy.

platform-ops-lina: Acknowledged.

cust-success-john: Thanks team.
